title: notification.send input
description: Input for notification.send: transactional confirmation, reminder, or handoff notification through an approved provider. Risk R4.

recipient_ref.description: Recipient reference, not an arbitrary destination.

template_variables.description: Structured variables for the approved template.

confirmation_token.description: Confirmation token; required unless hospital policy permits automatic sending for an already-confirmed transaction.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key that makes retries of the same request safe.
